jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact transparent 3x3 sprite atlas. In the top-left blank ivory body, REMOVE EVERY interior drawn panel seam and line: the curved upper-left arc, right angular panel seam, lower-left diagonal seam. Make it a completely smooth blank ivory oval shell with only its outer charcoal outline and broad smooth shading. In the top-center pointed leg, REMOVE the horizontal curved line near the top. Make it a smooth ivory tapered leg with just outer outline and soft shading. Keep it pointed, no foot. Retain the remaining seven face/hair sprites exactly as shown: colors, shapes, layout and clean unweathered surfaces. Do not add eyes onto the blank body. No gray patches, rust, cracks, scratches, speckles, seams, symbols, texture or fine interior lines on body or leg. Preserve same nine parts, exact atlas positioning, scale and transparent background. No labels.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Clean up this exact transparent 6-column 3-row atlas of 18 original cartoon robot enemies. Remove ALL rust patches, dirty mottling, chipped paint, scuffs, scratches and grunge from every enemy and every material. Use smooth clean colored surfaces and broad simple cel shading. Keep their distinctive colors, eyes, spikes, horns, antennae, drill, saw, cannon, tree leaves and silhouettes recognizable, in the SAME order and cells. Keep bold outer charcoal outlines and only necessary construction lines that distinguish major shapes; reduce fine noisy surface lines. No hands, no arms, no legs, no feet on any enemy. Preserve ALL 18 separate complete sprites, no overlap or clipped tips; give a little extra clear transparent gap between neighbors, especially blue cannon and tree and the red drill. Background must be fully transparent; no glow clouds or opaque backdrop, no text or labels. Keep landscape 1536x1024 layout.

Use smooth clean color and simple cel shading matching a clean cute cartoon robot. Preserve each accessory silhouette, colors and identity, bold outlines, hats, glasses, facial features, beard/moustache and head accessories, and same SIX columns FOUR rows ordering. Retain necessary shape-defining edges but remove fine noisy marks. The cheek patch should become a clean copper shape, not rusty. All 24 detached wearable components must remain isolated with generous TRANSPARENT gaps between them. Do not add heads, bodies, arms, hands, legs, labels, captions, backdrop or glow clouds.
